title: Page 169
transc:
Carey Lexington Ky  Washn Sept 5th 1864 
Francis plaster for Shelby Burr patron zebra
Jupiter directs that you relieve Palate E
A Pain from polka at Pay duke
a zodiac Judah does not deem him
fit to pontiac where there are any
loyal people webster Ireland that pains alleviated


Chas Armond Halifax  Washn Sept 6th 1864
Elizabeth Coax zebra Your wrangle rec'd & I'm
obliged to you tis very important to watch
Shelby Book zodiac Note who he associates with
how he talks and what he is at
habit for I think he means mischief on
the Pacific coast webster Bruno yours just arrived


Beckwith  Washn Sept 6th
Julia Dawson for Bellows Your whim of yesterday
is ambiguous stop Do you mean to repeat
to squadrern horse piddles the sick talbot whole
Morgan pelham or only talbot part of that
pelton now oxide spoon under Negus thats funny
